episodes.title: La mappa
episodes.summary: The map to a coveted treasure reappears. Filomena rebels and a spat with her husband blows up. Sparrowhawk makes a deal with the tyrannical Piedmontese.

episodes.title: Il fucile
episodes.summary: The Monacos welcome Filomena, but Ciccilla doesn't seem to trust her. Two helpers join Sparrowhawk's venture into Mignano's feared prison.

episodes.title: Il bue
episodes.summary: Filomena seems willing to prove her loyalty to Sparrowhawk, but she ends up making a reckless move. Fumel has plans for her. Michelina seeks allies.

episodes.title: Dalla terra si nasce
episodes.summary: Filomena wants to lead the Monacos to the gold — but when the gang gets threatened, Pietro suspects that there's a traitor among them.

episodes.title: La sposa, l'assassina e la pazza
episodes.summary: The gang is divided and Sparrowhawk's secret puts him in danger. Filomena doesn't know whom to trust. Michelina's domain is challenged.

episodes.title: Il pozzo
episodes.summary: Alliances are set, and the battle for the gold is imminent. Fumel's army feels lucky, but Filomena hatches a bold plan.
